description: The line plot, titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature,” illustrates the accuracy (Pass@8) of three methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of temperature, which ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 along the linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” spans from 62.5 to 80.0 in increments of 2.5. The orange line with triangle markers represents On-policy RL, starting at approximately 63.5 at temperature 0.1, rising to 70.0 at 0.2, peaking at 75.0 around 0.8, and ending near 73.5 at 1.0. The red line with star markers, corresponding to LUFFY, begins at 76.0, dips slightly to 75.5 at 0.2, rises to 78.0 at 0.3, peaks at 80.0 at 0.9, and ends at 80.0 at 1.0. The teal line with inverted triangle markers, representing SFT, starts at 76.0, declines to 70.0 at 0.5, rebounds to 76.0 at 0.6, dips again to 72.0 at 0.7, and finishes at 74.5 at 1.0. All three lines exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with LUFFY generally achieving the highest accuracy across most temperatures.
